name: @pipeworx/mcp-it-admin-courts

tools.name: search_rulings
tools.description: Search Italian administrative-court rulings (Consiglio di Stato and the regional TAR tribunals) by words or phrase, optionally narrowed by ruling type and by court seat. Covers public-procurement and contract-award disputes, planning and permits, public-sector employment, licensing and regulatory appeals -- e.g. rulings from the Brescia TAR naming a company or a tender. Returns each ruling's type, seat, section, number, ECLI, case number, a text snippet around the match, and a link to the full text; use get_ruling to read one. Italian search terms work best. Source: Giustizia Amministrativa. Covers administrative justice only -- not civil or criminal courts.

all_words.description: Words that must ALL appear, e.g. "appalto Brescia" or a company name

phrase.description: Exact phrase that must appear, e.g. "informativa antimafia"

seat.description: Court seat: "Consiglio di Stato", "C.G.A.R.S", or a TAR city such as "Brescia", "Milano", "Roma", "Napoli" (default: all)

tools.name: get_ruling
tools.description: Read the full text of one Italian administrative-court ruling found with search_rulings: pass its `case_key`, `file` and `schema` as returned there. Returns the court, ECLI where present, and the ruling text (truncated at max_chars). Source: Giustizia Amministrativa.

schema.description: Court code from search_rulings, e.g. "tar_rm" or "cds"

max_chars.description: Characters of text to return (1000-60000, default 15000)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-it-admin-courts forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the it-admin-courts pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
